property_summary: In the reference C, setL1BlockValues never changes any state, so l1FeeOverhead() always stays 0 for every input; the mutant stores the passed value, making l1FeeOverhead() nonzero for some inputs.
change_summary: Insert `l1FeeOverhead = _l1FeeOverhead;` after the require so the public getter l1FeeOverhead() returns the passed value.
